description: Check real-time appointment slot availability on a specific YYYY-MM-DD date at Bump to Baby in Montana, Pretoria. Returns studio trading status and open appointment times. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'check_booking_availability' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' or 'get_gestational_guide' for their respective operations). Parameters: date (required), service_type (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

date.description: Target appointment date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-11-14").

service_type.description: Optional scan package ("4D Scan (R850)", "Gender Scan (R600)", or "2D Scan (R500)").
